age.evidence: PDE samples were obtained from 20 stable PD patients treated per protocol (from a total of 21 enrolled, ≥19 years old, m/f: 13/7, free from peritonitis for at least 2 months).

Random allocation of treatments with AlaGln or without AlaGln in a ratio 1:1 was performed using RandomizerR (www.randomizer.at) and stratified by sex, age (< or ≥ 60 years), time on PD (< or ≥ 1 year) and peritonitis history (yes or no).
